 PVR INOX opens Rajasthan’s first IMAX cinema in Jaipur 
 Company Update 
 2 min read 
 PVR INOX Limited has announced the opening of its first IMAX® cinema in Rajasthan, located at Pacific Mall, Mansarovar, Jaipur. The new five-screen property features one IMAX® auditorium and four premium mainstream auditoriums, boasting a total seating capacity of 949 seats . Equipped with 4K laser projection and Dolby Surround Sound, this launch expands PVR INOX’s network to 1,802 screens across 359 properties in 114 cities.
 PVR INOX Expands Network with Jaipur Launch
 PVR INOX Limited, India’s largest film exhibition company, has launched a new five-screen multiplex at Pacific Mall, Mansarovar, Jaipur. This marks a significant expansion for the company as it introduces Rajasthan’s first IMAX® auditorium to the region. The cinema is set to open in time for the festive season, with the widely anticipated ‘Ramayana’ being the inaugural film.
 State-of-the-Art Facilities
 The new five-screen property includes one state-of-the-art IMAX® auditorium and four premium mainstream auditoriums. Together, these auditoriums offer a seating capacity of 949 seats . The cinematic experience is enhanced by advanced technology, including 4K laser projection , Dolby Surround Sound, and next-generation 3D capabilities. The venue also features Celebrity Recliners and an integrated Cinema Food Court with intuitive Self-Ordering Food Kiosks to offer a premium moviegoing experience.
 Network Growth and Market Position
 With the addition of this Jaipur property, PVR INOX has expanded its national network to 27 IMAX® screens and a total of 78 screens in Jaipur . Nationally, the company now operates 1,802 screens across 359 properties spanning 114 cities in India and Sri Lanka. This expansion underscores PVR INOX’s strategy to introduce differentiated, future-ready formats in key urban markets and strengthen its position as a leader in out-of-home entertainment.
 Management Commentary
 Mr. Ajay Kumar Bijli, Managing Director, PVR INOX Limited, stated, “The introduction of IMAX® in Rajasthan reflects our vision to make world-class entertainment more accessible across India. IMAX® is not simply a larger screen; it is a complete reimagining of how audiences experience a film, with extraordinary scale, precision sound and exceptional image quality.”
 Mr. Sanjeev Kumar, Executive Director, PVR INOX Limited, added, “At Pacific Mall, Mansarovar, we have brought together advanced audiovisual technology, Celebrity Recliners and an integrated Cinema Food Court to create a destination that feels premium from the moment guests arrive.”
 About PVR INOX Limited
 PVR INOX Limited is India’s largest film exhibition company, formed from the merger of PVR Limited and INOX Leisure Limited in 2023. The company operates 1,802 screens across 359 properties in 114 cities in India and Sri Lanka, offering a unified platform with deep industry expertise and a strong consumer-centric approach.
